mechanism_narrative: A decline in the federal funds rate signals an accommodative monetary policy stance, reducing discount rates for equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly CPI reading exceeding 305.0 signals persistent inflation, prompting the Federal Reserve to delay rate cuts and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances (CPIAUCSL > 305.0).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts and retail sales indicate deteriorating consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when both HOUST and RSAFS decline.

mechanism_narrative: In a low unemployment regime (UNRATE < 3.5%), a further decline in unemployment signals overheating labor market and impending rate hikes, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of instances when UNRATE < 3.5 and UNRATE declines.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly increase in non-farm payrolls indicates robust labor market conditions, supporting corporate earnings and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20-day returns in less than 40% of instances when PAYEMS increases.

mechanism_narrative: A monthly housing starts reading below 1600.0 thousand units signals a contraction in the housing sector, reducing consumer confidence and causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances (HOUST < 1600.0).

mechanism_narrative: A monthly industrial production reading below 102.0 indicates a contraction in manufacturing output, reducing corporate profits and driving negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20-day returns in less than 60% of triggered instances (INDPRO < 102.0).

mechanism_narrative: A quarterly GDP level exceeding 20280.0 billion dollars (indicating year-over-year growth above 2.0%) signals robust economic expansion, supporting equity valuations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60-day returns in less than 40% of quarters where GDPC1 growth (YoY) exceeds 2.0%.
